held-code-16k.text: Write a Python module for a durable append-only event journal. Include framing, checksums, recovery after truncated writes, atomic index rebuilding, filtering, and a comprehensive suite of failure-injection tests. Explain invariants in comments. Aim for at least 300 lines, beginning with the implementation.
held-code-16k.context:
class EventJournal:
    def append(self, event):
        encoded = encode_event(event)
        checksum = checksum_bytes(encoded)
        frame = encode_length(len(encoded)) + encoded + checksum
        self.file.write(frame)
        self.file.flush()
